[1/1] Add build depth and replayability: weapon evolutions (Ripper/Storm/Breaker/Reaper), champion mobs with Volatile/Shielded/Swift affixes, supply caches with a fair free-upgrade cap, three difficulty tiers with matching loot, level-up rerolls and banishes, and Shielder/Tunneler/Screamer/Phantom wired into the real spawn table

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for continued improvements to mechanics, balance and mobs; v0.6 builds peaked early, difficulty was fixed, and four designed mobs only existed behind test seams
impact_assessment.benefits: Visible late-game build payoffs, scarce and valuable elites, player-chosen challenge with matching reward, mid-run build agency, and full use of the mob roster
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save gains champion/cache counters, snapshot/seams expand, level curve and XP pace change; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: setup gains difficulty and existing saves default it to normal
impact_assessment.mitigation: 56 deterministic tests including evolution, champions/caches, difficulty, rerolls, new-mob states and persistence; seeded 4-minute balance runs; Chromium smoke with zero console errors; ADR-007

checkpoints.description: 56/56 node:test cases (9 new) and 5/5 Phase 4 gates pass; full-repo secret scan clean; Chromium smoke verified difficulty cards, evolution, champions, caches, codex and statistics with zero console errors; seeded 4-minute autoplays on Normal and Nightmare reached all 15 regular mob types, 2-4 evolutions, champion affixes and screamer rage, at ~1.6ms simulated frame time; balance re-tuned after finding 12% champions + 2-upgrade caches maxed every skill in 4 minutes (now 3% champions, 1 upgrade, 10-cache cap, steeper 6+6 XP curve); checklists: passed

[1/1] Add run variety and long-term goals: deterministic terrain hazards for all four maps, six opt-in run mutators with loot multipliers, two new active skills (Sentry Turret and Ember Aura), twelve lifetime achievements with shard payouts, and HUD/setup/codex/statistics surfaces for all of it

impact_assessment.why: The user asked to continue improving mechanics and balance; every map played identically, runs had fixed rules, active skills ended at blades/grenades, and lifetime stats had no goals
impact_assessment.benefits: Maps demand different movement, players can self-handicap for better loot, late builds gain two new active tools, and long-term play has explicit rewards
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save gains megaKills and achievements, snapshot/setup/seams expand, kill shard income reduced 30%; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: setup.mutators persists and old saves default to no mutators/no achievements
impact_assessment.mitigation: 62 deterministic tests, seeded 4-minute autoplays on mutator combinations, Chromium smoke with zero console errors, full secret scan, ADR-008

impact_assessment.benefits: Fills the defense build gap, completes the evolution system, adds three distinct threat archetypes and a third mega fight

impact_assessment.why: Runs can currently take all 19 skills, so builds converge and level-up choices lose meaning; the user asked for limits on skill number
impact_assessment.benefits: Creates build identity and real level-up tradeoffs, ties into existing armory metaprogression, keeps the 'everything caps at 5' contract
impact_assessment.risks: contract: level-up offers and applyUpgrade gain slot rules, snapshot gains slot fields; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: save.meta gains one additive key
impact_assessment.mitigation: Enforce in both offer generation and applyUpgrade, default missing meta keys to zero, full suite plus slot-specific tests and gates before commit

[1/5] Plan: v0.12 Salvage update - boss salvage crates with 3-choice relic cards, 10 relic effects on existing stat hooks, snapshot mods/relics and grantRelic seam

impact_assessment.why: Builds are now slot-capped but every boss only pays loot and banking shards; there is no run-defining reward choice from the hardest fights
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a third progression axis that does not conflict with skill slots, makes boss kills a decision point and creates build variety across runs
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot gains relics/salvage/mods and a new screen; dependency: none; concurrency: ledger shared; state: no save change (relics are per-run)
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep relics per-run only, reuse the level-up screen pattern, verify existing boss tests are unaffected, full suite and gates before commit
